There are no separate kits for host design systems or for every web framework. Instead, the brand
package publishes presets and theme objects, the web components cover any framework that renders
HTML, and every screen can be rebuilt with host components over a kit's headless layer. Each recipe
is written when the piece it uses ships; the list below is the index.

## Tailwind v4: the brand theme

Available today. `@polaris-key/brand` ships a Tailwind v4 theme whose utilities read the live
brand variables, so the theme and section switches apply to them too:

```css
@import "tailwindcss";
@import "@polaris-key/brand/tokens.css";
@import "@polaris-key/brand/theme.css";
```

The utilities are named after the tokens (`bg-surface-raised`, `text-fg-muted`, `border-border`,
`bg-accent`, `ring-focus`, `rounded-lg`, `shadow-elevation-2`); Tailwind's own palette is left
alone. This docs site is built on it.

## Index

| Recipe                      | What it shows                                                                              | Status                          |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------- |
| Tailwind v4                 | The brand theme above, and a kit preset over it                                            | Theme available; preset to come |
| Next.js App Router          | The React kit across a `"use client"` boundary, with a settings page                       | With the React kit              |
| Nuxt                        | The Vue kit's Nuxt module, rendering safely on the server                                  | With the Vue kit                |
| shadcn/ui                   | A component registry built on the React kit's headless hooks, served by Polaris Key        | Not written yet                 |
| MUI, Mantine, Chakra        | Theme objects generated from the brand tokens                                              | Not written yet                 |
| SolidJS, Preact, Qwik, htmx | The web components in each framework, and plain pages                                      | Not written yet                 |
| Go native                   | Each screen drawn with the host's own components over a kit's headless layer, per platform | With each kit's headless layer  |
